domain: switched delay systems with unstable modes under MDADT
limitations: Computational matrix verification rather than interval-rigorous certification; the tightest margins are about 1e-4 for the LMIs and 2.7e-5 for coupling. The delay derivative bound 0.2 is tied to the benchmark delay d(t)=0.2 sin(t).
provenance: Independent scientific re-evaluation on 2026-10-01 validated the finding.
record_title: Improved in-class MDADT certificate (0.5493, 0.1808, 0.2231) for the Hou-Zong 2018 unstable-delay benchmark
